issue: जेष्टानन्द बन्द सो सो निश्चय पावे — both witnesses print it so; बन्द is unclear (a poet's name जेष्टानन्द with बन्द 'bound'? or a garbled कन्द / बन्दि), and जेष्ट may stand for ज्येष्ठ.
our reading: as printed, read: Jeṣṭānanda (the poet) bows (बन्द = वन्द, बन्दना); each such one (सो सो) surely gains its reward
alternatives: ज्येष्ठानन्द कन्द (obtains him, the root of supreme bliss), not attested; Shubh Panchang (shubhpanchang.com) prints जेठानन्द आनन्दकर, another wording that does not settle बन्द

issue: सब संशय तारो … सन्तन सुखकारी — the stanza's two closing quarters do not rhyme (तारो / सुखकारी), unlike every other stanza; both witnesses agree, so a line may be corrupt in the common source.
alternatives: Shubh Panchang (shubhpanchang.com) prints सब संशय हारो (remove all doubts), which does not rhyme either; none attested that rhymes
